elements.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
elements.evidence: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time.

elements.element: Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
elements.evidence: The Company must provide ninety (90) days' prior written notice, exceeding 30 days.

elements.element: Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
elements.evidence: No prepaid fees are provided for in the supplied operative language; Section 3.1 instead provides a monthly Net Sales-based payment, so a pro-rata prepaid-fee refund is inapplicable.

elements.element: Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.
elements.evidence: Termination by HDI is expressly effective only at the end of the then-current term.

elements.element: Customer may terminate for convenience on 60 to 90 days' notice.
elements.evidence: The Company may terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' prior written notice.

elements.element: Any early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The Termination Payment is capped at the amounts payable to HDI under the fee provision in Section 3.1 for the three months preceding termination.

elements.element: Vendor may terminate for convenience only at the end of a term.
elements.evidence: The clause provides that termination by HDI is effective only at the end of the then-current term.

elements.element: Vendor must give at least 90 days' notice of convenience termination.
elements.evidence: The bilateral termination provision requires ninety (90) days' written notice, including for HDI.
